title: cli: indexing empty directory succeeds with no warning
description:
# Bug: Empty Directory Silently Succeeds

## Severity
P1 - MAJOR

## Description
Indexing an empty directory returns exit code 0 (success) with no warning to the user that no documents were found. This could mask issues where the user expected to index files.

## Reproduction Steps
1. mkdir /tmp/empty
2. ./doc_transformer index /tmp/empty --output /tmp/out
3. Returns exit 0 with "Found 0 files" - no warning

## Expected Behavior
Either:
- Return a non-zero exit code to indicate no documents were found
- Or at least print a warning message

## Fix Required
Add warning or non-zero exit for empty source directory.
